chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام: concerning
A man who kills a woman—he said: “If her heirs wish, they may kill him and pay five thousand dirhams to the heirs of the slain; and if they wish, they may take five thousand dirhams from the killer.”

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءِ اَلْمَقْتُولِ: the heirs of the slain person
key_terms.أَوْلِيَاؤُهَا: her legal heirs or guardians entitled to act in the case
key_terms.خَمْسَةَ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ: five thousand dirhams as the specified financial amount
key_terms.قَتَلُوهُ: they may lawfully kill him in retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shiʿi fiqh when a man kills a woman?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling regarding a man who kills a woman. It explains that her heirs have the option either to seek retaliation and pay a specified amount, or to take financial compensation from the killer.
